title: Timing Directions and Page Order
notes: Adds Top to Bottom and Bottom to Top to Shot Diagram Timing Sequence.
Sorts selected timing fills by column for vertical directions and by row for horizontal directions.
Makes desktop Shift-click fill a complete column when a vertical direction is active.
Adds Page Order / Renumber under Shot Diagram Page Tools.
Renumbers pages in report order while preserving every sheet's canvas position.
Does not change Firebase rules, cloud revision handling, calculations, imports, or document formats.
